segments.text: Greetings and welcome to this introductory module on BioRisk Management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习生物风险管理入门模块。

segments.text: BioRisk management encompasses both biosafety management and biosecurity management.
segments.zh: 生物风险管理包括生物安全管理和生物安保管理两个方面。

segments.text: In this introductory module, I will be introducing you to the fundamental differences
segments.zh: 在这个入门模块中，我将向大家介绍

segments.text: between biosafety management and biosecurity management.
segments.zh: 生物安全管理与生物安保管理之间的根本区别。

segments.text: I will also introduce you to some of the key terminologies used in the following lectures.
segments.zh: 我还会向大家介绍后续课程中使用的一些关键术语。

segments.text: Biosafety management pertains to the unintentional release of a biological agent.
segments.zh: 生物安全管理涉及的是生物因子的非故意释放。

segments.text: Unintentional release can be in the form of a breach of containment from a laboratory facility.
segments.zh: 非故意释放可以表现为实验室设施的防护屏障被突破。

segments.text: This release is not intended. However, it has consequences
segments.zh: 这种释放并非有意为之，但它会造成后果，

segments.text: and can pose a significant threat to public health and safety.
segments.zh: 并可能对公共卫生和安全构成重大威胁。

segments.text: Biosafety management, on the other hand, focuses on the intended release of a biological agent.
segments.zh: 而生物安保管理关注的是生物因子的蓄意释放。

segments.text: This concerns bioterrorism. A person with a malicious intent
segments.zh: 这涉及生物恐怖主义。怀有恶意的人

segments.text: can steal a biological agent from a laboratory
segments.zh: 可能会从实验室窃取生物因子，

segments.text: and use it to inflict a significant harm on public health and safety.
segments.zh: 并用它对公共卫生和安全造成重大危害。

segments.text: This is what differentiates biosafety and biosecurity.
segments.zh: 这就是生物安全与生物安保的区别所在。

segments.text: It is purely the intent of the end user.
segments.zh: 区别完全在于最终使用者的意图。

segments.text: We now move on to another key concept which is containment.
segments.zh: 接下来我们讲另一个关键概念，就是防护。

segments.text: Containment basically defines the limits of operation of a biological safety facility.
segments.zh: 防护基本上界定了生物安全设施的运行范围。

segments.text: In biological agents such as a virus or a bacteria must be contained within a facility.
segments.zh: 生物因子，比如病毒或细菌，必须被控制在设施之内，

segments.text: In order to prevent its escape and the consequent harm to public health and safety.
segments.zh: 以防止其逃逸并因此对公共卫生和安全造成危害。

segments.text: There are two basic kinds of containment. These are primary containment and secondary containment.
segments.zh: 防护有两种基本类型，即一级防护和二级防护。

segments.text: Primary containment pertains to the protection of the laboratory personnel
segments.zh: 一级防护是指通过采取相应的控制措施，

segments.text: from the biological agent by the application of pertinent controls.
segments.zh: 保护实验室人员免受生物因子的伤害。

segments.text: Secondary containment, on the other hand, pertains to the protection of the environment
segments.zh: 而二级防护是指通过采取相应的控制措施，

segments.text: associated with a particular facility from the biological agent
segments.zh: 保护特定设施周边的环境

segments.text: by the application of pertinent controls.
segments.zh: 免受生物因子的影响。

segments.text: Both primary and secondary containment must be applied concurrently
segments.zh: 一级防护和二级防护必须同时实施，

segments.text: in order to manage a biological agent effectively.
segments.zh: 才能有效地管理生物因子。

segments.text: What exactly are biological agents?
segments.zh: 那么，生物因子究竟是什么？

segments.text: Biological agents such as bacteria, viruses, fungi, prions and other subviral particles
segments.zh: 细菌、病毒、真菌、朊病毒以及其他亚病毒颗粒等生物因子，

segments.text: which pose a significant threat to public health and safety are classified as biological agents.
segments.zh: 凡是对公共卫生和安全构成重大威胁的，都被归类为生物因子。

segments.text: These biological agents are further defined into risk groups.
segments.zh: 这些生物因子又被进一步划分为不同的风险等级组。

segments.text: There are four risk groups as defined by the World Health Organization.
segments.zh: 世界卫生组织定义了四个风险等级组。

segments.text: In order to assess the risk posed by a biological agent,
segments.zh: 为了评估生物因子带来的风险，

segments.text: a thorough biological management system involves the application of a risk management protocol.
segments.zh: 一个完善的生物管理体系需要实施风险管理流程。

segments.text: We always commence biological safety management with a risk assessment.
segments.zh: 我们总是从风险评估开始进行生物安全管理。

segments.text: Following a risk assessment, we put into place the appropriate controls
segments.zh: 完成风险评估之后，我们会落实适当的控制措施，

segments.text: to mitigate or reduce the risk posed by a biological agent.
segments.zh: 以减轻或降低生物因子带来的风险。

segments.text: Finally, we assess the performance of the controls by auditing our performance.
segments.zh: 最后，我们通过对绩效进行审核来评估控制措施的效果。

segments.text: These three steps form the basis for bio risk management.
segments.zh: 这三个步骤构成了生物风险管理的基础。

segments.text: We commence with risk assessment, then we move on to risk mitigation
segments.zh: 我们从风险评估开始，然后进行风险缓解，

segments.text: and finally we end with performance assessment.
segments.zh: 最后以绩效评估结束。

segments.text: This is a cyclical process which is continuously improved
segments.zh: 这是一个不断持续改进的循环过程，

segments.text: in order to mitigate risks posed when working with biological agents.
segments.zh: 目的是减轻使用生物因子工作时带来的风险。

segments.text: Let us look at risk mitigation, risk assessment and performance assessment in separate topics.
segments.zh: 下面我们分专题来看风险缓解、风险评估和绩效评估。

segments.text: Risk assessment basically implies the usage of a risk matrix
segments.zh: 风险评估基本上就是使用风险矩阵

segments.text: to identify the risk posed by working with a specific biological agent.
segments.zh: 来识别使用某种特定生物因子工作时带来的风险。

segments.text: Risk is measured in terms of likelihood and consequence.
segments.zh: 风险是用可能性和后果来衡量的。

segments.text: For instance, a laboratory may host a biological agent in a refrigerator.
segments.zh: 例如，实验室可能会把某种生物因子存放在冰箱里。

segments.text: It does not pose any risk when it sits inside the refrigerator.
segments.zh: 它放在冰箱里时不会带来任何风险。

segments.text: However, when a laboratory technician begins to process this sample
segments.zh: 但是，当实验室技术人员开始处理这份样本，

segments.text: using different laboratory processes such as DNA extraction, protein extraction, PCR or ELISA,
segments.zh: 进行 DNA 提取、蛋白质提取、PCR 或 ELISA 等各种实验操作时，

segments.text: the risk level increases.
segments.zh: 风险水平就会上升。

segments.text: Risk is always measured in terms of the likelihood and consequence.
segments.zh: 风险始终是用可能性和后果来衡量的。

segments.text: We measure the likelihood in terms of the likelihood of the breach of containment
segments.zh: 我们用防护屏障被突破的可能性来衡量可能性，

segments.text: and we measure the consequence in terms of the impact on the laboratory user and the environment.
segments.zh: 用对实验室使用者和环境的影响来衡量后果。

segments.text: When we have assessed the risk posed by a biological agent
segments.zh: 当我们全面评估了生物因子

segments.text: and the associated operations thoroughly, we move on to the next step which is risk mitigation.
segments.zh: 及相关操作带来的风险后，就进入下一步，也就是风险缓解。

segments.text: Risk mitigation relies on the application of the five basic controls.
segments.zh: 风险缓解依靠实施五种基本控制措施。

segments.text: We have five controls. These are elimination, substitution, engineering controls,
segments.zh: 我们有五种控制措施，分别是消除、替代、工程控制、

segments.text: administrative controls and personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 管理控制和个人防护装备。

segments.text: Controls are used in conjunction with each other in order to mitigate the risk posed by a biological agent.
segments.zh: 这些控制措施要相互配合使用，以减轻生物因子带来的风险。

segments.text: Elimination is basically the process of not performing any operation with a biological agent
segments.zh: 消除基本上就是不对某种生物因子进行任何操作，

segments.text: because the risk posed by that particular agent is too high or if you do not have an appropriate facility.
segments.zh: 因为该生物因子带来的风险太高，或者你没有合适的设施。

segments.text: Substitution basically focuses on weakening the pathogen.
segments.zh: 替代主要着眼于削弱病原体。

segments.text: For instance, viruses can be attenuated or weakened so as to make them more manageable in a laboratory setting
segments.zh: 例如，可以对病毒进行减毒或弱化，使其在实验室环境中更容易管理，

segments.text: without posing a significant risk to the laboratory operators and to the environment.
segments.zh: 而不会对实验室操作人员和环境构成重大风险。

segments.text: Engineering controls are specific facilities which are designed to contain a biological agent
segments.zh: 工程控制是指专门设计的设施，用来防护生物因子，

segments.text: and offer a safe working environment to the laboratory users.
segments.zh: 并为实验室使用者提供安全的工作环境。

segments.text: Administrative controls pertain to the standard operating procedures
segments.zh: 管理控制是指标准操作规程，

segments.text: and other training which is provided to a laboratory user
segments.zh: 以及为实验室使用者提供的其他培训，

segments.text: in order to ensure a safe and conducive working environment
segments.zh: 以确保安全、适宜的工作环境，

segments.text: and in order to ensure the containment of that particular biological agent.
segments.zh: 并确保该特定生物因子得到有效防护。

segments.text: And you have the final level of mitigation which is the personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 最后一级缓解措施就是个人防护装备。

segments.text: I am currently wearing a biosafety suit which offers me protection against the biological agent.
segments.zh: 我现在穿着一套生物安全防护服，它能保护我免受生物因子的伤害。

segments.text: This will basically prevent my skin from contact with a biological agent.
segments.zh: 它基本上可以防止我的皮肤接触生物因子。

segments.text: However, if the biological agent is transmitted by aerosols, there is a risk of inhalation.
segments.zh: 但是，如果生物因子通过气溶胶传播，就存在吸入的风险。

segments.text: In this case, I have to use additional personal protective equipment
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，我必须使用额外的个人防护装备，

segments.text: such as masks or eyewear in order to prevent inhalation of that particular biological agent.
segments.zh: 比如口罩或护目镜，以防止吸入这种生物因子。

segments.text: Most of the respiratory viruses are transmitted via inhalation.
segments.zh: 大多数呼吸道病毒都是通过吸入传播的。

segments.text: In this case, one needs to use a proper risk mitigation measure
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，需要采取适当的风险缓解措施，

segments.text: such as a mask or a powered air purified respirator to prevent risk of exposure to that biological agent.
segments.zh: 比如口罩或动力送风过滤式呼吸器，以防止暴露于该生物因子的风险。

segments.text: Some biological agents may also be transmitted via the ocular route through the eyes
segments.zh: 有些生物因子还可能通过眼部途径传播，

segments.text: in which case one needs to use proper eyewear in order to protect oneself from this particular biological agent.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，需要佩戴合适的护目镜来保护自己免受这种生物因子的伤害。

segments.text: So these are the five basic controls elimination, substitution, engineering controls,
segments.zh: 以上就是五种基本控制措施：消除、替代、工程控制、

segments.text: administrative controls and personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 管理控制和个人防护装备。

segments.text: Once we have finished our risk mitigation, we look at the residual risk
segments.zh: 完成风险缓解之后，我们要看剩余风险，

segments.text: or the risk after application of all these controls.
segments.zh: 也就是在实施所有这些控制措施之后仍存在的风险。

segments.text: The laboratory users and the laboratory management must then decide whether this risk,
segments.zh: 然后，实验室使用者和实验室管理层必须决定，这种

segments.text: which is termed as residual risk, is sufficiently addressed in order to work in that particular facility.
segments.zh: 被称为剩余风险的风险，是否已得到充分处理，可以在该设施中开展工作。

segments.text: Please take note that residual risk may vary from facility to facility
segments.zh: 请注意，剩余风险可能因设施而异，

segments.text: and you will have to refer to your own unique situations in order to address this residual risk.
segments.zh: 你必须结合自己的具体情况来处理剩余风险。

segments.text: We now move on to the third step in Biorisk Management, which is performance assessment.
segments.zh: 现在我们进入生物风险管理的第三步，也就是绩效评估。

segments.text: Performance assessment basically involves auditing or looking back at your records
segments.zh: 绩效评估基本上就是审核或回顾你的记录，

segments.text: to determine whether there was any breach of containment.
segments.zh: 以确定是否发生过防护屏障被突破的情况。

segments.text: If you did observe any breach of containment in the form of an accident or an incident,
segments.zh: 如果你确实发现了以事故或事件形式出现的防护失效，

segments.text: you must go back and look at your standard operating procedures and modify them accordingly.
segments.zh: 就必须回头检查你的标准操作规程，并作出相应修改。

segments.text: Please take note that documentation is critical to every biosafety operation.
segments.zh: 请注意，文件记录对每一项生物安全操作都至关重要。

segments.text: One needs to maintain appropriate documentation and all documentation must be controlled
segments.zh: 必须保存适当的文件记录，并且所有文件都必须受控

segments.text: and traced in order to identify potential breaches of containment at a biosafety facility.
segments.zh: 并可追溯，以便识别生物安全设施中潜在的防护失效。

segments.text: So, that basically covers the key aspects of Biorisk Management.
segments.zh: 好，以上基本涵盖了生物风险管理的关键方面。

segments.text: We have risk assessment, risk mitigation by the application of the five controls and performance assessment.
segments.zh: 包括风险评估、通过实施五种控制措施进行风险缓解，以及绩效评估。

segments.text: I hope this introductory video has clarified some of the terminologies associated with Biorisk Management.
segments.zh: 希望这个入门视频帮助大家理清了与生物风险管理相关的一些术语。

segments.text: I will discuss these further in my forthcoming lecture notes.
segments.zh: 我会在后续的讲义中进一步讨论这些内容。

segments.text: We will focus on specific risk groups and the manner in which they can be mitigated in the following lectures.
segments.zh: 在接下来的课程中，我们将重点讨论具体的风险等级组以及如何对其进行风险缓解。

segments.text: Thank you very much for watching this introductory video. Please stay bio safe and thank you.
segments.zh: 非常感谢大家观看这个入门视频。请注意生物安全，谢谢。
